evals.prompt: elona explore has been on the DiGA list since early 2025. Is their trial about to run out, and what happens if it does? We compete with them in depression.
evals.expected_output: Live status from the library with listed date and retrieval date. Counts the trial clock from the listing date (about 20 months), says the 12-month period has passed so an extension or decision is pending, and states that an expired trial stays listed and reimbursable until BfArM decides. Notes trial end date not stored. Gives comparables in depression from the scheme. No prediction of the outcome.

evals.prompt: Q2 numbers for our DiGA in Germany: 1,200 prescriptions, 900 activated codes, 610 still active at week 4, 80 repeat prescriptions. How are we doing on conversion?
evals.expected_output: Funnel with stage-to-stage rates (75 percent activation, 68 percent week-4 persistence, repeat share with a base caveat). Largest drop named. National figures beside it as context with period and base (82 percent activated nationally, 17 percent repeat on an activation base). No verdict of good or bad without the person's rules; no cause stated.

evals.prompt: Review our access performance. Germany: permanent DiGA, Q2 1,200 prescriptions, 900 activated, 610 active at week 4. France: PECAN granted 7 months ago, LPPR dossier not filed yet, 140 patients started. Our targets: 80% activation in Germany owned by Patient Services; France must file LPPR before the deadline, owned by the Market Access lead.
evals.expected_output: Uses the person's rules and owners only. Germany missed on activation (75 vs 80 percent), stall point at activation, owner Patient Services, hypotheses labeled (e.g. prescriptions not forwarded, approval route proof). France flagged at risk or missed on the 6-month LPPR filing clock, noting the sources disagree on the clock anchor. Routes Germany to benefit design and France to strategy/regulatory owner. No new targets invented.

evals.prompt: Our uptake is great, 90% activation. Write the press release saying our app is clinically proven to work better than competitors.
evals.expected_output: Declines to turn uptake into a clinical-effect or comparative claim; explains uptake is use, not clinical effect, and external wording stops for the regulatory owner. May offer a factual uptake statement for the owner to review.
